propositions: ADF (nested JSON) is hardwired into Cloud REST v3 path while Data Center REST v2 uses plain text/wiki markup, requiring a pluggable RichTextCodec protocol to parameterize the difference

Current Cloud code duplicates map_fields_to_remote across backends, differing only in ADF vs wiki encoding; the shared implementation must relocate to jira_family/outbound_mapper.py taking codec as dependency

Four distinct rich-text operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must remain separate because Cloud callers compose them in different orders (fit+normalize vs fit-only) and changing composition would break J1-pinned oracles
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py (Cloud side) not jira_family/, to preserve J2's import contract forbidding jira_family from importing Cloud vendor modules

WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT=32767 with marker " … [truncated by reconciler]" (counted against limit), matching adf.py's marker wording for consistent user-facing behavior across deployments
